name: Msiexec.exe
description: Used by Windows to execute msi files
author: Oddvar Moe

commands.usecase: Execute custom made msi file with attack code
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Installs the target remote & renamed .MSI file silently.
commands.usecase: Execute custom made msi file with attack code from remote server
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Calls DllRegisterServer to register the target DLL.
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Calls DllUnregisterServer to un-register the target DLL.
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Installs the target .MSI file from a remote URL, the file can be signed by vendor. Additional to the file a transformation file will be used, which can contains malicious code or binaries. The /qb will skip user input.
commands.usecase: Install trusted and signed msi file, with additional attack code as transformation file, from a remote server
commands.os: Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11
